[Mats Malm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mats_Malm "Mats Malm"), the current permanent secretary of the [Swedish Academy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_Academy "Swedish Academy"), announcing the [2022 Nobel Prize in Literature](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Nobel_Prize_in_Literature "2022 Nobel Prize in Literature")

The [Nobel Prize in Literature](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Literature "Nobel Prize in Literature") ([Swedish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): _Nobelpriset i litteratur_) is awarded annually by the [Swedish Academy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_Academy "Swedish Academy") to authors for outstanding contributions in the field of literature. It is one of the five [Nobel Prizes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize "Nobel Prize") established by the 1895 [will](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Will_(law) "Will (law)") of [Alfred Nobel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel"), which are awarded for outstanding contributions in [chemistry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Chemistry "Nobel Prize in Chemistry"), [physics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Physics "Nobel Prize in Physics"), literature, [peace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Peace_Prize "Nobel Peace Prize"), and [physiology or medicine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Physiology_or_Medicine "Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-1) As dictated by Nobel's will, the award is administered by the [Nobel Foundation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Foundation "Nobel Foundation") and awarded by the Swedish Academy.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-2) Each recipient receives a medal, a diploma and a monetary award prize that has varied throughout the years.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-3) In 1901, the first laureate [Sully Prudhomme](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sully_Prudhomme "Sully Prudhomme") received 150,782 [SEK](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_krona "Swedish krona"), which is equivalent to 8,823,637.78 SEK in January 2018. The award is presented in Stockholm at an annual ceremony on December 10, the anniversary of Nobel's death.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-4)

As of 2025, the Nobel Prize in Literature has been awarded to 122 individuals.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-LiteratureLaureates-5) 18 women have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, the second highest number of any of the Nobel Prizes behind the [Nobel Peace Prize](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Peace_Prize "Nobel Peace Prize").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-WomenLaureates-6)[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature#cite_note-7) As of 2024, there have been 29 English-speaking laureates of the Nobel Prize in Literature, followed by French with 16 laureates and German with 14 laureates. France has the highest number of Nobel laureates.
